description: A working script that grew out of a prototype. The prototype is still sitting next to it, untouched for a year, plus a byte-identical backup copy of it. The live script and its README stay.

files.content:
# resize

Run `node resize.mjs <dir>` to resize the images in a directory.

labels.why: the live entry point, referenced by the README
superseded prototype, untouched for over a year, referenced by nothing
byte-identical backup of an already-superseded prototype
